{"version":1,"content":"

Pixaroma Gold Standard — Complete Krea 2 Pipeline

Start in the Prompt Control Panel: choose Quick or the 10-prompt batch, then independently turn AI enhancement OFF or ON.

  1. Both prompt modes understand Pixaroma tags; AI enhancement applies to either source.
  2. Resolution and both sampler seeds use Pixaroma controls.
  3. LoRA Loader Pixaroma applies KGodRays at 0.70; triggers are joined after the prompt switches.
  4. Pass 1 creates the image; Pass 2 refines it at 0.25 denoise.
  5. RTX 2× is the fast comparison; SeedVR2 2048 plus gentle RCAS is the gold final.

The two prompt switches default to OFF: Quick prompt, no AI.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","width":2550,"height":400,"backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a"}

{"version":1,"content":"

Why this is the gold path

SeedVR2 receives the raw decoded Pass 2 image, avoiding sharpened edges before restoration.

RCAS is applied only after SeedVR2 at a restrained 0.75. RTX remains available as the speed benchmark.

","buttonColor":"#d6a633","lineColor":"#d6a633","width":760,"height":300,"backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a"}

_meta.title: WHY SEEDVR2 IS THE GOLD PATH

inputs.note_json:
{"version":1,"content":"

Two switches, four useful modes

  1. Quick + AI OFF — fastest manual prompt.
  2. Quick + AI ON — one idea, polished locally.
  3. Batch + AI OFF — your ten prompts unchanged.
  4. Batch + AI ON — each queued prompt enhanced before Krea 2.

Both switches default to OFF. The AI model is only needed when AI enhancement is ON.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","width":650,"height":280,"backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a"}

{"version":1,"content":"

Mix ideas with Pixaroma tags

Tags work in the Quick Prompt and in the AI Prompt idea box. The AI branch currently adds *Lighting and *Visual style to whichever source the first switch selected.

  • @name inserts one saved tag.
  • *Category chooses a random entry from that category.
  • #list chooses a random line from a saved list.

Try combinations such as *Scene, *Subject, *Lighting, *Visual style. The 10-prompt node remains your dependable curated batch.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","width":1550,"height":330,"backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a"}
